name: AGEL 212326+015312 (Hubble)
blurb: AGEL 212326+015312, a strong gravitational lens, seen by Hubble.
label: cswa157-hubble
story: Here the gravity of a foreground galaxy bends the light of a more distant galaxy behind it, turning the pair into a natural lens.

claims.text: AGEL 212326+015312 is a lens system in the AGEL survey with a background source at higher redshift than the foreground deflector
The AGEL survey spectroscopically confirms strong gravitational lenses
